tagline: Jev ranks a command palette live as you type

examples.prompt: Set Jev Launcher up as a developer's command palette — targets for run-tests, open-editor, deploy, chat, music — each with good aliases. Type partial queries and watch Jev re-rank the field on every keystroke, then fire the winner on paper.
examples.caption: Jev's Palette — a fast decision model ranking launch targets live, per keystroke
